verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hosted TypeScript auth framework, since libraries and CLIs can ship usage tracking. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. Community remarks about owning auth data in your own database concern data residency, not telemetry, and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
